headline: Guard note for grammar.py edits
what_breaks: src/blib2to3/pytree.py — relies on Grammar class for parsing
src/blib2to3/pygram.py — depends on Grammar for grammar tables
src/blib2to3/pgen2/driver.py — uses Grammar for parsing engine
why: The Grammar class is central to the parsing functionality in this module. Changes to its structure or methods could disrupt multiple dependent files that rely on its implementation.
checklist: Review changes to the Grammar class and its methods.
Check for impacts on the load() and report() methods.
Ensure any modifications to instance variables are reflected in dependent files.
Verify compatibility with subclasses in conv and pgen modules.
